name: Gelato #33 Cartridge | 1g
description: This hybrid is a combination of Sunset Sherbet and Thin Mint GSC. Due to its compact buds in flower form, the cookie genetics are extremely apparent. This beautiful flower is dressed with dark green to purple buds and accented with fiery orange hairs.
